response.text: Let me check the AP journal pattern (invoice vs. payment journals), the accrual GL journals, memos, and the closed-period postings.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."REF_JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (1000,1001,2423,2460,802,2461,1364,2194,2459) OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_ID" IN (1,256,802)) ORDER BY 1,8

SELECT "SRC_CD", substr("MEMO",1,22) m, count(*), min("JRNL_NO"), max("JRNL_NO"), count(DISTINCT "SRC_REF") FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1, regexp_replace(substr("MEMO",1,22),'[0-9-]+','#','g') , 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC LIMIT 40
SELECT "SRC_REF", count(*), min("POST_DT"), max("POST_DT") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
